author: r1-flat
rationale: Flat recognizer: dense template matching of 10 hand-typed 15x12 digit glyphs at 5 vertical offsets over every column (one cell on 228-dim column windows), max over offsets; leftmost-ink detection gives 12 slot windows at a 12-px pitch; per-slot max of template scores becomes slot logits with a constant EOS logit; the step bundle selects slot[step] with a one-hot built from the step index.
